name: Neck pain and stiffness
note: From desks, phones and sleeping wrong.

name: Tension headaches
note: The kind that start at the base of the skull.

name: Whiplash
note: After a car accident or a hard fall.

name: Jaw and TMJ tension
note: Clicking, clenching, a tight jaw by evening.

name: Upper back pain
note: The knot between the shoulder blades.

name: Rib and breathing pain
note: A rib that catches when you breathe in.

name: Posture strain
note: Rounded shoulders, forward head, long days.

name: Low back pain
note: Sudden or years old, sharp or dull.

name: Sciatica
note: Pain that runs down the back of the leg.

name: Disc problems
note: Bulging or irritated discs, managed without surgery where possible.

name: Hip and SI joint pain
note: One-sided pain low in the back or deep in the hip.

name: Pregnancy back pain
note: Gentle, table-adapted care through every trimester.

name: Tailbone pain
note: Sitting hurts, standing up hurts more.
